versions.changelog:
- Added a new scenario describing mood tracking over a week, including a template for users to record mood scores by time of day and suggestions for analyzing patterns.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) to include the new mood tracking workflow.
- Added a README.md file.

- Major refactor: streamlined SKILL.md, removing detailed internal workflow, validations, and style/reference/test file dependencies.
- Consolidated and reorganized usage scenarios, workflow, and examples for greater clarity.
- Removed 5 internal reference files covering quotes, safety, style modes, few-shots, and test cases.
- Added version, tags, and made description more succinct in SKILL.md front matter.
- Guidance and response patterns are now more concise, focused on core function and safe expression.
v1.3.1: cleaned and expanded quote whitelist to 30 entries; whitelist-backed citation policy; safer fallback to natural unattributed lines; added style/test/few-shot references.
